name: inlineai
description: InlineAI for LinkedIn - open-source, bring-your-own-key Chrome extension that drafts genuinely personalised LinkedIn comments inline.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-content.mjs && node scripts/patch-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:only: vite build && node scripts/build-content.mjs && node scripts/patch-manifest.mjs

x-dependency-rationale.react: UI framework for the popup and options pages only (never the content script). Keeps the settings UI declarative and testable.
x-dependency-rationale.react-dom: React renderer for popup/options DOM mounting.
x-dependency-rationale.lucide-react: Tree-shakeable icon set for popup/options chrome. Only the handful of icons we import are bundled. The content script uses inline SVG strings instead, so this never touches the LinkedIn payload.
x-dependency-rationale.zod: Runtime validation of (a) settings read from chrome.storage.local, (b) LLM provider responses, and (c) provider configs. One small dependency that prevents an entire class of null/shape bugs.
